goal.answer: Perform a complete security and functional audit of the entire AV Traders application (backend + frontend), identify vulnerabilities and broken workflows, fix all critical/high issues, and deliver an AUDIT_REPORT.md summarizing findings and remediation.

payload.plain: Perform a complete security and functional audit of the entire AV Traders application (backend + frontend), identify vulnerabilities and broken workflows, fix all critical/high issues, and deliver an AUDIT_REPORT.md summarizing findings and remediation.

criteria.answer:
Security audit: Auth/OTP flows, JWT/session handling, admin route guards, SQL injection vectors, file upload validation, and sensitive data exposure are reviewed; critical/high issues are fixed and documented.
Functional audit: All major user flows verified end-to-end — Farmer register/login → chat/upload → solutions; Dealer register/login → browse products → place orders; Admin login → dashboard → unread/read/sent tabs → quotation upload → payments → LR number workflows.
Backend API audit: Every Express route checked for missing auth middleware, unsafe query construction, missing input validation (Zod or manual), error handling gaps, and inconsistent response shapes; issues found are fixed.
Frontend UI audit: All React routes verified, form validation checked, loading/error states reviewed, i18n (Kannada/English) toggle tested, Socket.io chat stability checked; issues found are fixed.
Deliverable: A findings-and-fixes summary file (`AUDIT_REPORT.md`) listing what was checked, issues found, severity, and what was fixed vs. deferred.

constraints.answer: Do not expose .env values, secrets, or credentials in any output., Do not change the authentication mechanism (session/JWT hybrid stays as-is)., Do not change the database engine or schema structure., Make the smallest safe fix for each issue; no large refactors or redesigns., Do not delete files or reset the database.

phases.answer: Backend Security & Functional Audit, Frontend Security & Functional Audit, Integration Verification & Audit Report

phaseSnapshots.name: Backend Security & Functional Audit
phaseSnapshots.goal: Audit the Node.js/Express backend for security vulnerabilities and functional defects, then fix all critical and high-severity issues.
phaseSnapshots.description: Review auth middleware, route guards, SQL queries, input validation, file upload security, payment webhooks, session config, and rate limiting. Fix gaps found. Verify all API endpoints return consistent responses and handle errors properly.

steps.description: Audit auth & session security: verify middleware coverage on all protected routes, check session cookie settings, JWT expiry/validation, and farmer route guards that rely on controller logic instead of middleware.

verification.command: grep -r 'ensureAdminSession\|authDealer\|requireAdminIfAdminRole' /home/chethan/Documents/bhaivatech\ project/avtraders/backend/src/routes/ && echo 'Auth middleware audit complete'

steps.description: Audit SQL injection & input validation: verify all model queries use parameterized statements, check Zod schemas cover all route inputs, and inspect dynamic SQL fragments for whitelist safety.

verification.command: grep -rn '\\$.*WHERE\|pool.query' /home/chethan/Documents/bhaivatech\ project/avtraders/backend/src/models/ | head -20 && echo 'SQL audit complete'

steps.description: Audit file upload & payment security: verify MIME whitelist, size limits, path traversal protection, and PhonePe webhook signature verification. Fix any gaps.
Audit functional API behavior: test key endpoints (farmer chat, dealer registration, admin dashboard, quotations, payments) for correct responses, error handling, and status codes.

verification.command: node /home/chethan/Documents/bhaivatech\ project/avtraders/backend/server.js & sleep 3 && curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:5000/api/auth/ping || echo 'Backend smoke test attempted'

phaseSnapshots.name: Frontend Security & Functional Audit
phaseSnapshots.goal: Audit the React frontend for security vulnerabilities and functional defects, then fix all critical and high-severity issues.
phaseSnapshots.description: Review route guards, XSS vectors (dangerouslySetInnerHTML), env leakage, auth state management, form validation, file upload UX, Socket.io stability, i18n, and payment flows. Fix gaps found.

steps.description: Audit frontend security: add route guards for /admin and /farmers/profile, review dangerouslySetInnerHTML usage for XSS bypasses, check env variable exposure, and assess Google Translate widget risk.

verification.command: grep -rn 'dangerouslySetInnerHTML\|VITE_ADMIN_EMAIL\|goog-te-combo' /home/chethan/Documents/bhaivatech\ project/avtraders/frontend/src/ && echo 'Frontend security audit complete'

steps.description: Audit auth state management: verify session persistence, 401 handling, logout cleanup, and dealer JWT storage (currently lost on refresh). Fix gaps.

verification.command: grep -rn 'localStorage\|sessionStorage\|Authorization.*Bearer' /home/chethan/Documents/bhaivatech\ project/avtraders/frontend/src/pages/ && echo 'Auth state audit complete'

steps.description: Audit functional UI flows: verify Farmer chat (upload, voice, reply, delete), Admin dashboard (tabs, quotation upload, LR, announcements), Dealer registration (docs, price list), and Payment checkout (deep link, status polling).

verification.command: grep -rn 'sendMessage\|uploadQuote\|startPhonePePayment\|sendMediaBatch' /home/chethan/Documents/bhaivatech\ project/avtraders/frontend/src/pages/ && echo 'Functional UI audit complete'

steps.description: Audit i18n and Socket.io stability: verify language toggle works for all hardcoded keys, check socket reconnect logic, and ensure Admin.jsx uses the shared socket instance instead of creating its own.

phaseSnapshots.name: Integration Verification & Audit Report
phaseSnapshots.goal: Run end-to-end integration checks and compile the AUDIT_REPORT.md deliverable.
phaseSnapshots.description: Build the frontend to check for regressions, do a final end-to-end walkthrough of the critical flows, and write the AUDIT_REPORT.md summarizing all findings and fixes.

steps.description: Build frontend to verify no compilation errors or broken imports after fixes.

verification.command: cd /home/chethan/Documents/bhaivatech\ project/avtraders/frontend && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -5

steps.description: Write AUDIT_REPORT.md with sections: Scope, Security Findings (severity + fix), Functional Findings (severity + fix), Deferred Items, and Recommendations.

assumptions.answer: Working against a local dev environment (backend on localhost:5000/5100).; MySQL database is already set up with the provided schema.sql.; No existing test infrastructure (Jest/Vitest/Cypress); audit is manual + static analysis.; Fixing only bugs/issues surfaced during the audit, not adding new features.; 'Test a to z' covers all documented features in README, not every possible edge case in every line of code.

payload.summary: Phase 1 (Backend Security & Functional Audit) completed. Key achievements: removed hardcoded JWT secret, added farmer/admin session middleware, protected all unprotected chat/payment/quotes/farmer routes, verified all SQL is parameterized, added missing Zod validations for dealer/phonepe/translate endpoints, confirmed upload security (MIME whitelist + UUID), fixed unprotected payment status endpoint with ownership checks, fixed critical chat endpoint ownership vulnerabilities (impersonation + unauthorized thread/message access). Deferred: public upload serving auth and runtime DB integration tests.

grade.rationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.
